# Vendored: esp-web-tools 10.1.1

Files in this directory are the unmodified `dist/web/` browser build of
[esp-web-tools](https://github.com/esphome/esp-web-tools) version **10.1.1**,
fetched from `https://unpkg.com/esp-web-tools@10.1.1/dist/web/` and pinned.
License: **Apache-2.0** (© ESPHome / Open Home Foundation). Vendored so the
flasher page loads no third-party CDN. To upgrade: bump the version in this
note, re-fetch `install-button.js`, and follow its relative imports until closure.
